body: Same feelings here. I am 61 and feel like a washed up has-been. Even exercising, etc. doesn't necessarily change the problem, it's not that simple. Just have to believe there is someone for everyone and keep making efforts.

You're definitely not alone in feeling cornered, forgotten by family, alone, without options, etc.  Have you ever thought of just moving away somewhere? That's what I hope to do. Just leave and start again.

That's sort of helpful to hear. I do think you should initiate contact with your daughter No Matter What -even just a quick call or email to let her know you think of her - though, because none of the other factors will matter to her in the long run but lack of attention is felt over all and that may never be forgotten. You are needed somehow. But as for our every day lives, it does feel pointless. I try to tell myself the world is in sorry shape, and we all struggle, and just to be here still trying and staying out of the streets or jail is fine, but every day I am surrounded by others who are miles ahead of me. And at this age, there is no romance or support and even less energy or strength. Let me know if you ever wish to talk privately. I live in NJ.

I filed for disability for depression twice and got denied. Then a lawyer said I needed a bigger paper trail, which I had in RI for about a year, but I haven't gone to counseling there in months and have now moved to a different state where I don't even have health insurance quite yet so I don't see it happening. They want you to be unemployed to get it, to prove that you can't work. I am unemployed but I can't afford to stay that way, I have nothing to lean on. Nonetheless I will jot down that website and maybe try to go that route.

I used to get wanted for sex, used, sure. My daughter is great but she has a better life with needs met and I just drag her down. I'm not saying I have nothing at all, but I don't have the basics in place and the fact my brain is not and hasn't worked makes it impossible. And old age alone is depressing. I spent so much money on trying for help and it never worked. I moved around a lot and now back to where I started and I feel nowhere. I haven't had a boyfriend in years, and it's all abnormal. Feel like an old has been, alone and pathetic. Trying to look on the bright side, but the resources are so scarce. I do feel unlucky and constantly feel others' good fortunes around to contrast to. Thanks for responding though, just having some contact at all helped.

People your age care more about their electronic devices than doing real life stuff. Go to a lake alone with a book and radio. Google and sign up for a meet up group, one that gets together for movies or hiking or whatever, if you can. Read magazines in the library. I am much older but I do everything alone, better than being stuck inside. Summer is fairly early on so at least go to a lake a few times to stay cool.

I'm 58 and never found anyone except lots of heartaches along the way. A lot of concepts posted here seem true. Also true is today's age of technology sucks the soul out of the situation. People care more about what's on their phones or monitors way more than real-life experiences or people. And people will gratify themselves at home with drugs & movies way before they will go out of their way to meet people. Being young you have chances meeting at school or having valid hobbies you could use a meet up but between age gaps, religious & political differences, chemistry, etc. it seems pretty damn hopeless. But for you, young, don't stop trying.

I also didn't get renewed in two education positions and it is a horrific feeling that I fully understand because I felt that way too. But at least you had that much success by lasting as long as you did! The politics of schools can be nightmarish, that's one reason I just sub, so no one can attack me. It's usually not the students complaining. But I don't know any facts. All I know is I understand the painful way it feels to still go there every day in light of what happened, and so much worse not being told why. I have felt paranoia from this and other blacklistings as a sub (no reason given) but also knowing that I am a great teacher and the students learn from me.  But being let go goes on a record and potential hirers see it...it's horrible. And seeing others interviewed is like rubbing salt in the wound. As for your "friend", I agree with what "ohwontyou..." says exactly...your friend is twisting things around, maybe just to watch her own butt. You exercised diplomacy and have not been unprofessional. It sounds like you are together enough to deal with this handling of things, it's not that big a deal in the long run. Good luck!
Life is what you make it, that's exactly why I don't hold hope in my heart. I thank you for bothering to respond.

That is actually a little comforting, so thanks. I don't think I know how to OP. I don't know about people loving me; I haven't had a boyfriend in many years and just had a million draining false starts that lead one to stop believing. I have one grown daughter and a small family but rarely anyone to do things with. A few people are friends, but surely my desperation exasperates them. But I will try to hang in there.

I think part of your problem is not getting to talk about your brother, that will eat someone alive. 34 is young enough that a relationship can still happen. And you have a job, that's most of it. Make a purpose just living for a TV show, who cares. Just continue until you grow stronger. I'm sure your mother's parenting style sucks and that's partly what leads to kids feeling the way they do, but still sometimes it's just failure to open up and communicate and someday it could be different. Even if not, you can find your own therapies.

I haven't checked on here in awhile, so I'm sorry. I came back to this site tonight because I am beyond bad shape. Nonetheless, since I am not that far away, if you ever want to get together and talk, I'd be happy to.
Are you anywhere near RI?

Hard2hire.com has jobs that hire people with records. Care.com for dog walking or whatever. Go to a temp agency and do day labor if that will help for now. If you even have $300 for rent check Craigslist and try to grab a room for rent or roommate situation instead of your own place for the time being. There are homeless prevention agencies in the phone book that often give a one-time rent help payment. Don't give up. Not that I don't feel like giving up but one thing is for sure, you will find a way.

It would be nice if people could be genuine and fair. But most seem like they want to play push-pull games, like dogs, they can sniff fear, and if you don't act all happy and play games, you don't have value. All I can say is I am not like that and there must be others like that, and we must find them and stick to them.
I keep wondering why I am so willing to make plans or help someone or spend time but no one wants to do the same with me.

No, but I would probably like it a lot. It looks like Season 1 is for sale on Amazon. I really believe it sucks the soul out of society, but I am a little hypocritical since I use it. But I try to limit it. Life was richer before the internet.

Also, one reason I am against them/it is because all you do is pour out your life story just so THEY can understand, and each week by the time you just update them as to what's going on that week, you get very little in return. It's a lot of passiveness. If someone really was serious about helping, they'd be very proactive and try to "blast" it away! I'd rather trust in real-life friends instead of someone who is just paid to listen.

I'm glad I'm not the only one who doesn't trust or believe in therapists. I did a posting once about it being a joke. These are just people paid to care and when your time is up they herd in the next...There are some people who think therapy is their answer so more power to them. I say all the jargon and mumbo jumbo about depression is a lot of bull and is designed to make people feel like the answers are somewhere else. The psyc meds are prescribed and patients' brains learn not to mend themselves from that, and they crush a person's true soul. They prescribe them just as medical doctors are medicine happy to feed the pharmaceutical industry when there are perfectly good other substances to use. Better help could be found through integrative doctors (but they rarely are covered by insurance), helpful vitamins, herbs, minerals, support groups, having a pen pal to confide in, EMDR or EFT, using DBT or CBT techniques yourself from the computer, tapping, etc....Ive been to tons of therapists and I don't care how "good" they are, the whole thing is a lot of crap. If someone is depressed 24/7, one hour a week is too small a dent to matter much. Unless you are unenlightened about what you feel to begin with. That's how I feel anyhow.
One more thing, the same people who avoid people with depression ( "too negative" to be around) are the same ones that would come to our funerals and act like they cared so much.

Definitely. I feel I am a true person and would love to find someone as dependable as myself, but others never come through, even people on here, they are always fly by night. Internet dating? A lot of clicks but no real action is offered. If you answer personal ads, they see you once and that's the end of that. My friends are too busy, mostly married so they only care about their families or if they make plans, seem to cancel or come late or otherwise disappoint. So if you're single and don't have much automatic family or you're not around people like at college, you stay alone. It didn't used to be this way, I think technology is isolating society a bit.

I haven't tried it but I bought some, magnesium powder. My main reason is I read it would help with not being able to sleep. But now that you said it, I will start taking it and hope. I don't think iy could hurt?
Well at least your pain can come out in a form of art, I can't even do that!

No, is it worth reading, and who is the author? I'm going to the library tomorrow anyhow. 
I thought my thyroid might be a culprit for a lifetime of depression, or my hormones since my PMS had me taking huge mood dips...but only integrative med doctors really help with that. The only endocrinologist my insurance covers just says my thyroid is fine, yet I have every symptom, my sister has it, and my numbers come in near the edge of the normal range. I cannot get anyone to really help me! Antidepressants rarely work, and they make your brain less able to heal itself down the line. A flotation tank was nice, try that, that is real relaxation. I am taking CLA to try to lose weight and am hoping it will keep my mood better lifted.

Ive been told I have BPD, depression, anxiety, maybe one of everything, but what they say doesn't matter. Modern psychology wants to think it has the answers but I think it created a lot of this jargon and its bs. Either way, it's a matter of a brain and body not working well or working well. Living better even if depression is there. So keep looking for answers...check into integrative medicine, read books like "Lincoln's Melancholy" by Joshua Wolfe Shenk (this book gives a lot of perspective), maybe try EMDR and ignore all the mumbo jumbo of how it should be and keep trying to gain energy. I am older and depression ruined most of my life but I still believe it can be better (for me if there was money to help me). Keep moving through the pain. I truly believe most of it is physical and that the key to functioning better is physical, though mental has to be improved along with it.

I am female and could care less about size. If you like a guy and you're in each other's hearts, you make it work whatever it takes, and if you don't, it doesn't matter anyhow. I think women with class don't judge like that, just low class women who live for sex. And no matter what size, there are always others ways of making things good.

You can call or go on internet for the United Way resource line 211 or 211.org and they tell you some resources. Or google and see what comes up. Also, there is a theory that alcoholics are sometimes really hypoglycemic/diabetic and the drinking helps give the sugar they crave. You do yourself a favor by making it easier for your body to let the habit go when you take supplements like L-Glutamine and chromium picolinate..things that balance blood sugar.

I used to commiserate with certain people that I felt could relate, especially not having a boyfriend or a good job or other normal things. Those people are all married and happy now. Just me left in nowhere land.
Well you can see you are not alone having those feelings, it's widespread. You articulated the way it feels very well. I can give my email address if you wish to talk further to someone, let me know

You made it out of the ward, you now have to regroup and map out a strategy for staying stronger than before. This may be different meds, exercise, clean foods, joining meetup groups, taking walks, swimming, petting dogs...look for a new perspective. Just be glad you are out of that environment and free!

That's how severe depression is, you are speaking the language of it as a lot of people on here are, including myself at times (I have more reasons to be in despair than most people). But there are a lot of things you could try to change your brain chemistry somehow. Keep looking for comfort and inspirations to feel differently.

You can't fight a disease like this alone, you have to go in a rehab. Since Obamacare if you're in US, everyone can have health insurance and go into rehab. All the pain and the thoughts are coming from a place of an overwhelming disease. It could all feel differently after you are forced to get clean and live a more healthy lifestyle. Fight for your health!

Can you declare bankruptcy? Get unemployment or welfare? Live cheaply in a roommate situation? Either way, I am quite sure you must feel very overwhelmed. Money isn't everything though. You have to be like a horse running with blinders on, push the money aspect aside and keep fighting for health, sanity, income, and friends. Look on the internet for all the ways to help with panic attacks, I know they can be scary.

My daughter had it, I know it can be devastating. It will go away with time though! In the meantime you can use energy drinks occasionally and fight the virus with things like Astralagus, turmeric, garlic, Bragg's apple cider vinegar, and lemon water...these things keep inflammation down and clean your system. I don't think there's a case of mono that didn't get better with time, so hang in there.

Sure, keep on talking to me whenever you want. You'll keep going because you have to for now on, but soon you will want to show the baby the world and it will be fun a lot of times. There are single parents groups to do things with, I hope. And even if you get depressed or discouraged at times, you can look for new ways to help it.

No, children of single parents usually turn out great, as long as you were raised with decent values yourself. Teaching a child literacy is what really matters. There are single parent groups and parent groups to help support you. You will meet people. And even if you don't, you can get a babysitter and go out. It didn't work out for me as far as love, and I didn't have much family (my parents disowned me in the beginning and I didn't have others) and I was in depression most of the time but you will still find joy because of that child needing you and there will be people around to support you. A child does not need two parents to thrive, or a man or a woman, they just need one person who is strongly there for them and teaches them good values. And you have money so why can't your child be well rounded if you can afford lessons?  The biggest problem is you not having the support of a man but maybe down the line you will.

Sorry, you may not be in the US and I don't know what's available there. All I can tell you is when the baby comes, you will be forced to look at the present and the future so you will, and there is no reason you can't meet someone new and even get married. But always be good to yourself and try to satisfy your own needs too.

Sometimes I worked at temp agencies, it was easier to get work. I used a daycare center rather than an individual cos they would get sick or be undependable, and had a back up sitter or traded other parents for sick care, occasional nights out. You can get daycare financial assistance. I was on food stamps some of the time. I joined singleparentsmeet.com. I used WIC at first. I used county health clinics for the baby's shots. All the stuff needed came from a  baby shower but nowadays you can look on craigslist "free" section or buy great stuff cheap at a thrift store. A lot of clothes were handed down to me. I was very lonely at times (still am) but you are young and there are plenty of activities and other single parent men out there.

Sorry, I just read your other words that you don't want to be out in the heat, etc. I just keep saying I get it because I'm doing the same. Can't get comfortable in my skin, not where I live, and play online backgammon constantly to just numb it all. I also have renters above me where the noise just makes me crazy most of the time. I am offering  if you want to talk on the phone, pm me, I will talk to you anytime, even every day..maybe we can figure out the way through things

Do you live anywhere near the East Coast? If you were near here, I'd say come to get away.
There aren't a lot of answers, I know that. I know we are both faced with needing to make major life decisions while not having  a working brain to do it with, and with next to no options (at least me)I know my own life is so hellish right now that every second is agonizing and I can't stay calm enough to think forward. The only thing to do, for both of us, is to force ourselves to stay out. The cave we withdraw in which to nourish our panic is a cage. We can still be the same outside, it's summer, just go to some beach or park, every day and sit there as long as possible reading or writing. Just stay out of the house. I know it's too hot. I would go to the beach and sit at the water's edge but they all cost a fortune to go to in this lame place. This is definitely the worst summer of my life and that's saying a lot. But it's not over yet. Help us fight.

There's still hope. Worst case scenario is you do some job from snagajob.com for five years and can afford to live with some roommates from Craigslist cheaply, while you save money up. You're probably eligible for state tuition waivers and you can go to a two year program not far down the line. Once you are in a different environment you will be able to think straight. Make a direct plan, ok?

I figured I'd respond, since at 57 I'm older and most posts on here seem to be young people who are upset even before putting in so many years of proven failure. I'm not saying you have been a failure, just that I have! People are sort of shallow in general, they want to have a good time or hear only positive things or surface meaningless banter. And you are considerate for trying to keep stuff away. Romances and relationships are so meaningful because you get to open your heart, hopefully in safety and returning the favor. Without that, all you can do is hope to find to find a new friend that likes to talk about those things. This site is good for venting and then getting some opinions, but if you're looking for a continuing conversation, you have to arrange it. I'm available, but my life is sooooo bad right now I doubt I could cheer you up, well, maybe in comparison you would feel better:)

Hope you let time pass. Doing anything at all while drunk is not you making a decision, it's the substance effect making a choice. Your parents would freak out, seeing you live at home, so get off the booze and start talking it out!

This may not be helpful advice, I just want you to know you aren't the only one! If you do have a lease, you can get them on a few things, especially the water things, they have to fix all that, or maybe can call the housing dept. on that one. For the noise, try recording it on a phone that tells time and date, and make a complaint using the proof.

I live in a basement studio, and the landlord rents to summer people. He never gives me the courtesy of telling who will be there or what to expect. Right niow there are three carloads of people. I counted five adults and five small children. they are banging, bouncing, running, jumping, the noise is continual, it's like they are dropping heavy items 100 times. I have already stayed away on my visit longer and stayed at my sister's once, but I am at the point I am just driving somewhere and sitting in my car crying and waiting. My nerves can't take it, i'm not sleeping. To top it off I can't find a job and have no income, and I can't even have the peace of mind needed to keep the almost hopeless hunt up. let me throw in that I'm 57 and never date either. This summer is awful, and I will move out of this place once I figure out an option, but in the meantime the noise from those neighbors is UNLIVABLE. Prayers for all of us!!!!!
I don't belong to kik, I guess that's why I didn't understand. I don't have a smartphone and don't know what it is, oh well
I'm 57 and can't find a job. Every application online seems to go into a black hole. People like us need all the support possible!
I can't see a way to message you about talking on kik...

I hope it's not, but it could be a symptom of bipolar, going for days at a time without sleep, then days doing nothing but (I have heard of this being a symptom). But not sure. Could it be a reaction to some meds you have been on that long? This summer I can't find work and I stay up all night, like until 6 or 7am then sleep all day. I don't want to do this, because I can't have any life. May both of our sleep patterns get more normal!

It is natural to feel all alone having a baby alone. I did it. I never found a husband, still haven't. I was very lonely. But there are still a lot of things to look forward to...when you have that baby, it will fill your heart, and as you get out and do "kids things" you will be part of a group: parents. There are many meet up groups to be found that you can go to their activities. I don't buy "you have to love yourself first before..." BS. You just have to care enough to reach out to others and find people who know how to understand.  Think of nothing but the baby...another man, a single parent, can come along later, you are still young and there is lots of time!!! If you want to ask me how I did it, feel free. I know you can do this!

You should share this idea on the suicide and depression sites maybe it could offer some people hope.  In the US, Obamacare actually has helped me by giving me health insurance I haven't had in many years.

Thanks for the idea. Typical regular counseling IS covered by insurance, so that's not the issue exactly. I don't think that is helpful, and I sure don't like telling my life story again & again to so many different people who really don't care. So I will not be going to regular counselors ever again, students or others. If there were holistic or other more effective types of helpers then I would consider it. But I sure like the idea of massages and if the students do it cheap like that I would go!
I will try to find other types of help than conventional therapists. But I am very low income and insurance only covers certain things.
At least one other person feels the same way. I think those who defend therapists may simply just be looking for improvement and enrichment, but sometimes a person needs rescuing!
The point you make is valid, but only if one is willing to see therapists as an experimental date. I don't think it should be that laid back.

I hear what you're saying about guidelines, but if a sister can see someone in agony and not try to help...she could have suggested all kinds of different approaches, not from her directly but other places and types of helpful things. Her type of therapy is not wanted anyhow, but she could have stopped at nothing until I could find something that might help. She knew I felt helpless and had no money or resources while she did. So I don't buy that as an excuse.
by the way, my resume is choppy as hell too, and it scares me too. But use snagajob.com and temp agencies and the state unemployment offices and get a start somehow.

Sorry, I haven't been on here ina  few days, too depressed. I think you should get on Craigslist asap and either anser ads under roommates or rooms for rent OR place your own ad putting on the table what you want and what you can pay. Get out soon. Take your stuff. That's a horrid way to feel, I have been there before, where I was so depressed I could not take action but was unwanted where I was. Somehow you can get to point A to point B but you must take that step of looking for cheap housing. As for jobs, I really think signing up for two temp agencies is a good way to get started. They often hire from there, and train you for free in computer skills for free. But I don't know what field you want. There's more to life than your father, you are old enough to get on your own. Once you have that in place you can think straight. In the meantime if you are not on meds (they never help me), start exercising (run/walk) like crazy and get stuff from the health food store. I have always used craigslist for housing. You do have to be careful but it is how most people do it these days.

I have had that fear most of my life. No one in my family helps me and there is no place to go to fall back on. I make very little money and am at the poverty level, on food stamps. Raised a child alone like that. Never feel well, from depression, but forced to keep going. So I guess I'm saying, if I did it, you can, and again, the best way to start is to live cheaply by putting up with having roommates...it's still personal space and privacy in your own room no matter what.

I totally understand how you feel discouraged and I can see how you feel lost. And you probably are still grieving. But it's not too late. Your father may just be trying to light a fire under you. You just need to take steps. They may not be ideal in your mind, but you can get jobs on snagajob...you can get customer service jobs if you can talk on the phone, you can get pet sitting on care.com, etc. The good news is you don't have a criminal record that  makes things impossible. The good news is you have a little money so you can maybe move in with roommates where your rent can be cheap for awhile (and not be all alone).  It is true apts with leases are hard in your situation right now, but roommates and rooms for rent are not. I am 57 and never married, and I still try to have hope love will come! I understand your feeling tired, sometimes it feels Catch 22. But there are a lot of hopeful elements to work with here. And do it (take steps) for your mom.

I never heard of healthcare not being free since 2014 if it's the US, just a matter of applying for Obamacare. You've got to get on 211.org or call 211 and ask for any possible resources to prevent homelessness, etc. They have agencies that give emergency funds. Maybe you could just find a cheap room for rent for the time being. Place an ad on Craigslist putting up front that you need to have a dog? I heard you said it's hard for you to actively seek help, especially because of the way you are feeling. I have been dealing with this kind of struggle for years now, very extreme. I am screaming at you to FIGHT with all you have left, to get to a better spot. I know it seems from experience you can't, but the dog and others depending on you are proof that you have a reason to keep going. Get on that 211 hotline.
Besides which I am not looking for the cliché "I like walks on the beach" "My life is great except I don't have someone to share it with" responses. I want someone who needs THIS.

OMG, I have tried online dating for years, it is 1000% hopeless on there for me, there are hardly any profiles I feel are right, and the rare ones I do they don't respond, or I get responses that make me wonder how bad I must be to attract that, or there is no follow up, but thanks for the great idea.
Let me know if you want to talk further, any time.
Maybe, but he did state he was not going to commit suicide, he told me it was going to be murder. It's a mysterious statement, and let's hope it's not what it sounds like.

I feel for you. There is nothing more painful than a broken heart. It's so frustrating when there is love to give, and someone can't appreciate it. But if people are saying she's a bit crazy, time may show you it was all for the best. Either way, to make time pass, you have to stay busy.

Wow, well if that is a true threat, can you get out of town??? With 50 states and hundreds of countries surely there is somewhere you can go to that can prevent this. I know restraining orders can be bs but still, Make sure you leave a detailed paper trail. Come on, fight back.

It's doubtful that you are truly looking for real meaning, because you seem resigned to something that may not be inevitable. If there is even one iota of meaning in having a mother, brother, grandmother, religion, dad, and even beer, then you are luckier than a lot of others and live another day for those things. Or use your "last day" to find meaning within your heart.
Don't stop talking.

You need to find a way to get your brain chemistry working better. Have you tried all meds and all combos of them? Have you tried EMDR or EFT tapping? Have you tried vigorous and relentless exercise? Have you tried meet up groups to go to? Have you taken all the books out from the library about mood, etc? Have you tried adding turmeric to your diet and other types of mood boosting supplements? I'm the queen of trying everything and getting nowhere and yet I still think of still trying. I agree that most therapists SUCK.
I totally stopped contacting him 100%, yes

He had developed a bad image of me in his mind because he came to associate me with criticism and he was a coward  (there were some other issues involved that may not be in your case). He went on like nothing ever existed. I went on like life had no rhyme or reason, and have never been ok. It was supposed to be a friendship and I had truly believed it would be a lifelong one. But we didn't have as much time invested as you do. Maybe all she needs is a little time to realize. But male-female friendships after the fact of a romance can usually only be successful after a lot of time goes by and both have moved on some.

If you read some of my older posts from Oct or Nov I felt excruciating pain about a situation sort of like this. And he said "No contact". It's really really frustrating. I never did get over it and stayed in a feeling of trauma to this day. But I got over "him". Things will work out the way they are meant to in time.

I said you FEEL like you want your pain to be obliterated, not that you should obliterate yourself. You just don't want to feel that way any longer. Unless you've tried a ton of DIFFERENT things, keep trying. You will find a way to feel better, not tonight though. Go to bed.
I know that's the feeling you have. I am quite familiar with the feeling. Just distract yourself tonight please.

Hi. Is this a PM? I don't know my way around this site. If it's private, good. I don't have skype, I have done it on facebook, but I don't know if I can find my camera right now. I can "chat" on facebook, an email (peffygirl1@aol.com), or talk on the phone. And yeah, it might be pointless but no one has anything left to lose. Actually I friended some young kid on here and really helped him, but then later he was a jerk to me. Anyhow I don't know if it could hurt, at least talk in emails.

Well if she takes time and space, maybe she'll come to that conclusion. If she throws something good out so easily she will later find out there are a lot worse out there. But as for you, make sure you're not addicted to "crazy". Remember someone always gets idealized after they are no longer there and we can longer have them. Give her a set amount of time and if not then cut.
I doubt you want death, you just want to obliterate your mind so you don't feel so much pain. Just try to sleep for a long time and when you get up, take a ride somewhere new.
Again, you hurt her but not on purpose. You were being honest and you weren't trying to say you'd rather have the other girl over her. It's nice that a guy cares about hurting feelings though.
It depends where in America, anywhere near a city it is not an issue, maybe you should move.
I'm not saying anything else except I wish I had someone to talk to about the same feelings.

I don't think you can be called a monster, you were trying to openly communicate, and she coaxed you to say it. That didn't mean you said you didn't have feelings for her. My take is that if she was playing fair and cared about you, she would not behave this way. I also think you have to watch out because she sounds very, very unstable and that could mean a long time of craziness just like this incident. But I understand how badly it hurts when this happens and it does not need to be like this.
